limitations: All100 windows reused from development, not fresh holdout. No parameter, timing, phase, pitch, or per-voice fit.
Polyphonic tour has inferred gates/program alignment, chorus, hardware Reverb and unknown capture dynamics. Candidate ranking does not identify OPU envelope constants or absolute timing.
Pair RMS matching discards absolute gain evidence. Error metrics do not quantify perceived authenticity.
Longer envelope changes model voice overlap, oldest replacement, spectral balance and inter-program tails. Hardware allocator/voice limit remains unverified.
Instant attack sentinel AR>=63, AR0 disable, RKS law, raw RR remapping, D1 endpoint, 96dB endpoint, waveform and LFO remain fixed. This tests scalar timing only.
No synthetic/capture-noise bed. Copyright source media stays ignored/local.
Voice pressure uses model public activeVoices() and exact existing noteOn replacement condition; no inference that hardware stole corresponding notes.

protocol.program_policy: Full absolute timeline from zero; program changes update future notes only; prior release voices remain active. Programs precede old note-offs then stable new note-ons at equal frames. Both source channels share program but preserve note-off identities.
protocol.score_windows: 100 exact prior v4 windows; short preset windows, not isolated final note-off tails.
protocol.latency_policy: Remove32-frame declared integer latency only; Recorded chorus epoch -32/48000 before render. No local lag/phase/pitch fit.

decision.status: All three scalar candidates remain research-only; no blanket adoption
decision.reason: Decay/release x3 has a small all100 joint-band mean improvement, stronger aggregate STFT improvements and better target mean, but51/100 band regressions including Hand Bell+3.673dB and Sitar+2.551dB. Slower attack/RR-only worsen all100 band mean. All three increase voice pressure sharply. This tour and a possibly processed sibling recording cannot identify envelope law.
decision.next_evidence: Controlled isolated direct-output captures with known raw patches, exact gates, FX/Sustain states, TL/compression checks and long silence tails. Prioritize AR/D2/RR rate sweeps, Reverb off/on, absolute unnormalized envelope slopes and attack shape; compare within known gate-relative segments without fitting per-case timing.
decision.human_voice_release: Candidates improve some Human Voice1 tour metrics but no isolated real PSS780 gate-off tail was newly measured here; requested release mismatch remains unresolved.
